## Question

What is the magnitude of the force \( \vec{F} \) on the \( -10\,\mathrm{nC} \) charge in figure?

## Answer choices

- A: A: 7.25 \times 10^{-3}N

- B: B: 6.35 \times 10^{-3}N

- C: C: 7.3 \times 10^{-3}N

- D: D: 1.33 \times 10^{-3}N

## Figure caption (auxiliary; use the image as primary evidence)

The image depicts a simple diagram involving three point charges placed at the corners of a right triangle. 

- The bottom-left charge is labeled as \(10 \, \text{nC}\) with a positive sign, indicating a positive charge. It is depicted in red.

- The bottom-right charge is labeled as \(-10 \, \text{nC}\) with a negative sign, indicating a negative charge. It is depicted in teal.

- The top-right charge is labeled as \(8.0 \, \text{nC}\) with a positive sign, indicating a positive charge. It is also depicted in red.

- The horizontal distance between the charges labeled \(10 \, \text{nC}\) and \(8.0 \, \text{nC}\) is given as \(3.0 \, \text{cm}\).

- The vertical distance between the charges labeled \(8.0 \, \text{nC}\) and \(-10 \, \text{nC}\) is given as \(1.0 \, \text{cm}\).

The lines connecting the charges are dashed, indicating the geometric relationships between them.
